descriptionChirho: Nifal passive sense: to be charred, scorched, or burned by fire.
Qal intransitive sense: to burn, glow, or be consumed by fire.
Piel causative sense: to kindle, set ablaze, or stoke a fire.
Nifal metaphorical sense: to be incensed or burn with anger.
Nifal sense of desiccation: to be parched, dried up, or made hoarse by heat.
